milestones: Repository unpacked and architecture audited.
One-button Windows play launcher.
One-button LAN build-sharing launcher and LAN package scripts.
One-button Windows test and production-build launchers.
Unified `npm run verify` workflow.
Developer sandbox entry point using `?dev=<mode>`.
Sandbox pause/resume, one-tick step, simulation speed, and basic spawning.
War-table camera iteration one: pure math module, camera-relative pan, middle-mouse orbit, smooth zoom, and bounds.
Cursor-anchored zoom over the battlefield ground plane.
World-space move, gather, and rally command confirmation markers.
Camera math test suite authored (execution pending dependencies).
New design notes captured as decisions/backlog rather than left in chat.
Complete supplied CodePen set captured in the permanent art-reference log, with intended use and the bloom-only caveat recorded.
Eleven first-party concept images archived, interpreted, and integrated into the GitHub README/gallery.
One-page public development site added at `/development.html`, including a browser-play CTA and automatic progress synchronization from this file.
Permanent agent reasoning and work-quality protocol added, with structured analysis, honesty, verification, and documentation requirements.
Expanded sandbox diagnostics: scenario presets, FPS, draw calls, triangles, entity totals, camera state, and selected-unit order readout.
Camera-safe box selection with reusable rectangle math, depth visibility rejection, and dedicated tests.
Overlap-aware click-picking priority with dedicated policy tests.
Attack and invalid-order acknowledgement added to the existing command marker system.
Camera focus and cursor zoom now follow the real terrain mesh rather than a flat plane.
Toggleable developer order-line and selected-radius world overlays.
Visible generated build identifier for LAN/web tester bug reports.
Optimized production LAN build-and-preview launcher.
Repeatable performance harness with quality-tier URL overrides, p50/p95 frame timing, and portable JSON report export.
Versioned deterministic save files with browser quick-save/load, JSON import/export, map compatibility checks, and state-hash validation.
Pure cinematic replay-director policy with event ranking, shot/cut safeguards, manual override protection, and dedicated tests.
Live human commands routed through a single recording gateway without losing UI command results.
Replay format v3 records AI match setup, endpoint tick, and optional final state hash.
Sandbox replay export, exact re-simulation verification, and verified endpoint import/playback.
